text:
Maya (eng): Heads up — thinking of tweaking the weekly triage call format. Backlog's creeping up and long tails are eating the meeting. Proposal: add a short 'lightning rounds' slot for quick blockers/RFC triage and rotate a bug-bucket owner each week. Thoughts?

Jon: SGTM. What time are we keeping it? Wed 10am right now — still good for most folks? Also can we add a 1–2m PR-review ping line so owners can call out urgent reviews.

Owen: Wed 10 still works for me. +1 to lightning rounds, but let's cap items to 2m each or we bleed time. For owner rotation, maybe pick from oncall/triage roster so it's not a random volunteer.

Rachel: I can take next week if that helps — will go through the bug-bucket and assign clear owners. I'll also flag infra-blocked items.

Maya (eng): Awesome. Draft agenda (30m total):
```
1) Quick metrics / backlog heads-up (2m)
2) Bug-bucket owner report (8m)
3) Lightning rounds — up to 6 items, 2m each (12m)
4) RFC/design quickcalls (5m)
5) Action items & owners (3m)
Total: 30m
```
Please keep lightning items strictly 2m: problem, ask, owner. If it needs more, schedule follow-up.

infra-bot: Calendar: recurring event still Wed 10:00. Description updated to include link to bug board when users add it.

Jon: I'll update the recurring invite and put Rachel as owner next week. Also adding a sticky line in the invite: `If urgent, drop into #eng-oncall`

Owen: Tiny operational asks: 1) ensure owners add a follow-up issue if they commit to a fix, 2) if owner can't make, assign a delegate in the thread beforehand. I'll put a 1-line owner checklist in the handbook.

Rachel: Done — put next week's owner in the invite and added the board link: https://redwood.infra/boards/bugs-42. Also added a short owner checklist in the calendar description: `Owner: <name> | Board: <link> | Follow-up issue w/ assignee`

Maya (eng): Perfect. Let's try this format for 3 weeks and review during the next retro. If no objections I'll push the agenda change and lock the invite.

Jon: No objections from me. :thumbsup:

Owen: :thumbsup: I'll publish the owner checklist and a tiny template for lightning round items.

Rachel: :) Looking forward to a tighter meeting.

Maya (eng): Thanks all — will update the handbook and notify #eng.
